name: switchboard
description: Picks Haiku, Sonnet or Opus for each subagent before it starts, with Jev or simple rules. One line per spawn above the prompt; /route shows each pick and what it cost.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto (default) runs each subagent on the picked model. suggest only shows the pick.

jevApiKey.title: Jev API key
jevApiKey.description: TypeSafe API key for Jev. Each spawn sends the task's description and its first 6,000 characters to api.typesafe.ai. Empty uses TYPESAFE_API_KEY, else rules only and nothing is sent.
